infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Thallo uses the camera to scan food barcodes and take food photos for nutrition tracking.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Thallo reads your resting heart rate, steps, workouts, sleep, and active energy from Apple Health to calculate your fitness score and recovery status.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Thallo saves your completed workouts to Apple Health so they appear in your health timeline.
